subject: Confession: I built this at 2AM
preview_text: The real story behind the feature that saves relationships. It started with a text I almost ignored.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM, and I was staring at a screenshot of a conversation that made my stomach drop. My best friend had sent it to me, asking if she was overreacting. I knew she wasn't, but I also knew she'd ignore me if I said it. So I coded the first version of what would become our pattern detection tool right there, in the dark, on a laptop balanced on my knees.

I wasn't trying to build a business. I was trying to give my friend the proof she needed to see what I saw. The next morning, she scanned the same conversation and saw the toxicity score. She finally broke up with him three days later. That's when I knew this wasn't just a tool—it was a way to bypass the denial, the excuses, the 'maybe I'm crazy' cycle.

That feature is now your relationship health dashboard. It doesn't just show one red flag—it tracks patterns across every conversation you scan, so you can see if something is a one-off or a recurring manipulation tactic. The gaslighting detection was calibrated using the same texts that kept my friend stuck for months.

Open the app and scan a conversation you've been second-guessing. Let the data tell you what your gut already knows. P.S. The pattern detection works even on old screenshots—scrolling through your camera roll might reveal something you missed.
